description: Ranks the public welcome (sign-up) offers on cards the user doesn't have by first-year value: the bonus at the user's point values minus the first year's annual fee and any membership the card needs that the user doesn't have. Offers the issuer rules out because of a card in the user's wallet are marked likely not eligible and listed last. Use it when the user asks which new card to get or which has the best sign-up bonus. It covers only the cards earnrate knows, offers vary by person, and each offer's note gives the issuer's eligibility rules; pass those caveats on. It doesn't account for what a card would earn on the user's spending.

business.description: Business cards instead of personal ones.

cards.description: Cards the user named in this conversation, to answer for just those cards without saving anything. Leave out to use the user's saved wallet if they have one; with neither, the answer covers every card earnrate knows.

activated.description: Bonuses the user has activated with the issuer, as rule ids from search_cards.

picks.description: Bonus categories the user picked, for cards that have them: choice id → option ids, from search_cards. Ask; don't guess.

includeHeld.description: Include cards already in the wallet.

kind.description: cash: cash back cards only. points: points and miles cards only.

noAnnualFee.description: Only cards with no annual fee.

valuation.description: Instead of the user's saved point values (or earnrate's defaults): flat, points at their cash-out value, MR and UR at 1¢; or points-heavy, MR and UR at 1.7¢, for people who transfer points to airlines and hotels.

name: compare_welcome_offers
title: Compare welcome offers
